component: Detached sufficient statistics for masked joint validation loss

inspected.finding: DistributedDictMeanCounter averages already reduced batch scalars with one count per update; it cannot recover masked component denominators.
Validation passes batch scalar dictionaries into DistributedDictMeanCounter; no occupancy-actor loss statistics interface.
Attribute/speed training losses reduce weighted foreground denominators through the detection framework, without a detached joint validation statistics interface.
Semantic and geometry losses return scalar means; no actor/occupancy/kinematics sufficient-statistics closure.

search.decision: Neither reference supplies the masked joint validation statistics function. Implement a project-owned opt-in output at the existing reductions; no new reference code or dependencies copied.

interface.flow_and_consistency: return_statistics=True adds statistics to the existing loss dictionary; defaults retain existing keys and scalars.
interface.adapter: JointTrainingAdapter.validation_statistics(..., generator=...) returns component -> {numerator: detached scalar tensor, count: detached raw scalar count, weight: float} from one objective pass. Adapter training_loss defaults to scalar; its opt-in return is (scalar, statistics).

components.actor_fm: Masked pose and available velocity elements; actor_weight.
components.occ_actor_consistency: Eligible actor-frame ROIs containing known voxels; occ_actor_weight.
components.temporal_consistency: Consecutive known same-static-class voxel entries expanded across six semantic classes; temporal_weight.
components.kinematic_velocity: Available consecutive pose transitions expanded across XY velocity dimensions; kinematics_weight.
components.heading_alignment: Available transitions passing speed/class masks; class weights remain in the numerator, kinematics_weight.

interface.aggregation: Sum numerators and raw counts per component across batches/ranks, then sum weight * numerator / max(count, 1). Empty sets export zero numerator and count with the configured weight.

validation.red: Before production edits: all 8 initial new tests failed at missing return_statistics / validation_statistics interfaces.
validation.coverage: Independent recreation of existing flow scalar formulas and literal mask counts; exact scalar/gradient/RNG equality between opt-in and normal calls; one field evaluation; three modes; three variable-mask batch partitions with fixed stochastic realization; geometry ROI exclusions; distinct velocity and heading denominators; detached outputs; empty counts and fixed weights.

runtime_boundary.reference_files_unchanged: Inspected source SHA-256 values checked again after implementation; hashes unchanged.

license: Existing provenance and copyright/license notices remain applicable; no new upstream code copied. Unresolved upstream terms remain documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
